description: Add a reference document to the workspace Brain from pasted text or from source_url, a public PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown file (10 MB max; web pages return 415, so send their text instead). Supply exactly one of text or source_url, plus an optional title, document_type and tags. The text is extracted and indexed for aidelly_search_brain. Requires workspace settings permission; a workspace holds at most 50 documents. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

source_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown file (10 MB max). Web pages (HTML) are not accepted; send their text as text instead.

text.description: Document text. Supply exactly one of text or source_url.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_add_brain_document
title: Add Brain Document
